'''Affogato''', or "affogato al caffe", is an Italian preparation consisting of [[Cookbook:Gelato|gelato]] or [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]] topped with [[Cookbook:Coffee#Espresso|espresso]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nolan |first=Greg |date=2018-04-26 |title=An Introduction to Affogato (Recipes and Tips) |url=https://ineedcoffee.com/an-introduction-to-affogato-recipes-and-tips/ |access-date=2023-10-21 |website=I Need Coffee |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Ingredients ==
* 1 scoop [[Cookbook:Gelato|gelato]], typically [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* 1–2 shots [[Cookbook:Coffee#Espresso|espresso]], or one long pull shot

== Procedure ==
# Either pour espresso over gelato and serve, or serve them side by side for diner to mix at the table.
